about_short_description.short_description: Avion School is a provider of software coaching services.

product.name: Full-Stack Web Development Course
product.description: An online coding bootcamp teaching HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and Ruby on Rails to prepare students for software engineering roles.

product.name: Career Placement Support
product.description: Services including resume reviews, interview preparation, career consultations, and job referrals to assist students in securing software engineering positions.

identifier.value: Income Share Agreement (ISA) Tuition Payment Option

product.name: Income Share Agreement (ISA) Tuition Payment Option
product.description: A tuition payment plan where students pay 17% of their monthly salary for two years only after securing a job.

product.name: Installment Tuition Payment Plans
product.description: Flexible tuition payment options allowing students to pay in 2 to 18 monthly installments through partners Billease and Bukas.

identifier.value: Part-Time and Full-Time Online Coding Bootcamp Schedules

product.name: Part-Time and Full-Time Online Coding Bootcamp Schedules
product.description: Flexible course schedules offering a 12-week full-time or 24-week part-time online coding bootcamp to accommodate different learner needs.

product.name: Programming Language and Framework Courses
product.description: Individual courses teaching specific programming languages and frameworks: HTML & CSS, JavaScript, React, and Ruby on Rails.
